worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.summary: Scatter petals onto a chosen ally and bloom on it twice: the first flower heals half on the spot, the second opens a moment later and reads the ally's Grassy Terrain at that moment; together they restore about half its maximum health, more on Grassy Terrain. This move targets another ally only.
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.use.0: Heal an ally from a distance
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.use.1: Make the second flower stronger on Grassy Terrain
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.use.2: Buffer an ally's damage with a two-beat heal
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.descript: The two flowers together restore %1$s of the ally's maximum health (before Grassy Terrain, never past full); a stronger bond grows a richer bloom. If the ally still stands on Grassy Terrain when the second flower opens, it heals an extra %2$s.
Can only be cast on a chosen ally within %1$s blocks, never on yourself.
The first flower opens at once; the second opens %1$s later. An ally downed or gone in between cancels the remainder.
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.stance.b: Bouquet: slightly more healing (x1.06), at the cost of a 0.9x range and a longer cooldown - for close care.
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.stance.p: Plain: reaches farther with a shorter cooldown - for rescues across a gap.
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.timing: Cast on an ally; after %1$s s of wind-up it spends %3$s PP, then recovers for %2$s s with a %4$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.floralhealing.preferen: On: x1.06 healing, but a 0.9x range and a longer cooldown. Off: a longer reach and a shorter cooldown.
The companion blooms on an ally below this health ratio; lower keeps attacking, higher rescues at the first wound.
The companion blooms only on an ally within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher closes a gap first.
